name: Part B value model v0.4a on TRUE policy references (no walls): build, fit, contrast acceptance
controller: partB_v0 gbm (variant auto) per tau, policy-conditioned, deployable_strict HEADLINE / deployable_detector SENSITIVITY; per-CAV action tokens (CAV_RAW 20); wall tokens empty
question: Can a deployable policy-conditioned value model V(s,tau,pi) predict remaining delay with calibrated uncertainty under true fleet policies (native, damping, PI) and switching/fixed mixes, and give skilful policy contrasts dV = V(a) - V(native) on held-out worlds with true references (Q2, untestable in v0.2-v0.3.2)?
scenario: Saved-state continuation labels from chunk-4 base/native_base/native/pi/fixed/switching arms, chunk-2/3 J3 truearms native/pi and bases; chunks 1-3 + fix27 switching arms AUXILIARY training only; TRAIN/CAL by each chunk WORLD_PLAN split, HOLDOUT never opened
budget_registered: ZERO SUMO/TraCI; CPU <=4 workers low priority; est. build 2 h, two refits 1 h, ablation+report 1 h
budget_actual: ZERO SUMO held. Build 1376 sources + parity + backup 6886/6886 (previous session, commits 956e335/264d971); 3 fits + strict_noaux ablation (attempt-1 launches died at start with MemoryError, receipts kept; attempt-2 verified); plumbing dry-run re-run 2359 s; ONE CAL read 1221.3 s; per-dir pytest ~35 min total. Executor change: Sonnet stopped by owner decision mid dry-run (no CAL read), GLM Flash resumed in wd01v04c from 15def5f.
results: ONE CAL read (lock CAL_READ_ONCE_v04a.json written before the first CAL row). VERDICT per registration s.6: FAIL for strict (HEADLINE), detector (SENSITIVITY) and strict_noaux (ablation). Strict A2-gating PASS (MAE+CRPS beat ridge at tau 30/60/120; also PASS at 300, FAIL at 570 reported) and every tau beats climatology CRPS, but A1 fails (overall 10-90 coverage 0.880 > 0.85 band edge; detector coverage 0.805 in band -> A1 PASS there) and A3 fails for both gating contrasts: sign accuracy on |dY|>TRAIN-median pairs PASSES everywhere (damping-native 0.867-1.000, pi-native 0.909-1.000 at tau 60/120/300) but the dV CRPS does not beat BOTH the zero-contrast and TRAIN-cell-mean baselines at any gating tau (0/3). Removing auxiliary rows changes almost nothing (coverage 0.879, still 0/3 A3): the failure is not an auxiliary-data artefact. TRAIN-OOB versions agree (all FAIL). %-of-mean scale (Appendix A of REPORT_V04A.md): strict MAE 13.7-18.6% of the TRAIN mean target across taus. vs v0.3.2_strict: CRPS improves at every tau on the larger TRUE-policy CAL set (e.g. tau 30: 169.9 vs 198.3) and A2-gating holds, but the old 'native' was a switching mix (WM-72), so the contrast blocks are not comparable pairwise.
criteria_verdict: FAIL (ACCEPT requires A1 AND A2-gating AND A3 on both gating contrasts; A1 fails for strict/ablation on coverage and A3(ii) fails for all three variants at 0/3 gating taus)
limitations: Ideal-sensing premise (lane bins from the true state; reconstruction gap measured separately in Part A). Chunk-2/3 CAL previously read once each (v0.3.2, RESCORE1) and chunk-4 CAL is also C4L1's Part A look set: this run is the disclosed third read of chunk-2/3 CAL, second of chunk-4. Single-realisation truth per world (no replicate expectation). Contrast CRPS evaluated on 23/27 CAL pairs per tau (9-23 worlds): sign CIs are wide. The conformal band is too wide on CAL for strict (0.880); PI/damping true gaps are small relative to world noise, so a zero contrast is a hard baseline. No walls (deferred to v0.4b).
